required_inputs.instruction: I need A concrete target to ping (the exact IP address or hostname of the AWS endpoint the users are trying to reach). Also confirm the test source/context: should the ping be run from the firewall 'fgt_casa' (provide the inventory identifier or management IP / source interface) or from a host in subnet 192.168.241.0 (provide a host IP)? to execute 'ping' on fgt_casa.

I need IP o hostname válido para hacer ping. Necesito al menos uno de los siguientes (no puedo inferirlo):
  - La IP o el hostname exacto de la "página principal de AWS" que se quiere comprobar (por ejemplo el FQDN que los usuarios intentan alcanzar),
  - La IP del gateway de la subred 192.168.241.0 o la IP de la interfaz interna del FortiGate asociada a esa subred (si el ping debe ejecutarse hacia el firewall/gateway),
  - La IP de un host dentro de la subred 192.168.241.0 para comprobar conectividad interna.
Además indique desde qué dispositivo/ubicación debe ejecutarse el ping (p. ej. desde el FortiGate, desde un host cliente, o desde una herramienta de diagnóstico). to execute 'ping' on users_192.168.241.x.

I need Which exact target should be pinged and from where? Need (A) the intended ping target: either the subnet gateway IP for 192.168.241.0 OR the external AWS host/IP (the 'main AWS page') to test. The previously used value 192.168.241.1 is unreachable and cannot be assumed correct. And (B) the origin of the ping: the device/host to run the ping from (e.g., FortiGate device identifier or its management IP, or a host on 192.168.241.0). to execute 'ping' on users_192.168.241.x.

I need Target device to query for config-sync status: provide the device inventory identifier or management IP (or confirm the device with serial 'FGT60ETK19031088' is the target). Also confirm whether this FortiGate is part of an SLBC/HA cluster and the FortiOS version/build if available. to execute 'fgt_monitor_sys_get_config_sync_status' on aws_main_page.
required_inputs.value: It is not a ha cluster
